# Photo Map - Location Viewer

> Browser-only photo map: drop in photos and see where they were taken.
> GPS coordinates and capture dates are read locally from EXIF data —
> photos never leave the device. No backend, no accounts.

Photos are grouped by city (reverse geocoding sends only coordinates to
BigDataCloud), shown on a Leaflet map with clustering, a capture-order
timeline, a calendar of photo days and an optional travel route with
numbered per-city flags. Everything persists locally (localStorage +
IndexedDB) and works offline as an installable PWA.

## Links

- [Live app](https://photo-map-location-viewer.netlify.app)
- [Source & docs](https://github.com/piecioshka/photo-map-location-viewer)
